title: observable — one entry in the shared vocabulary (plan.md 1.1 S4)
description: A name that means the same thing on both sides of the bridge. Two agents agreeing on a word while disagreeing on the estimator is the failure this registry exists to prevent: the numbers are then compared and nobody can see why they disagree.

definition.description: What the quantity is, physically. A name alone is insufficient (5.4).

units.description: allowed units from units.json; all entries must share a dimension

estimator.description: How the number is obtained from raw data or trajectory. This is what makes two sides comparable: 'diffusivity' from a video and 'diffusivity' from a trajectory are the same observable only if the estimator matches.

window_required.description: true when the value depends on a lag, window or interval. Then it is not one number, and the plan must carry the window as a condition.

window_parameter.description: required when window_required: the name of the condition that fixes it

producible_by.description: a vocabulary entry only one side can produce is still legitimate; the bridge refuses to ask for it (4.4)

comparable.description: true when the same estimator runs on both sides, so a round trip can compare the numbers directly (S4)
